subject.title: [优化建议] 添加结构化错误处理和智能重试机制

question: Which installer npm failures should OpenClaw auto-retry or auto-repair, and where should it only print remediation guidance?
rationale: The source-level gap is real, but cross-platform npm prefix repair, transient-network retries, and optional setup probe strictness can change install behavior and need maintainer intent before a safe implementation.

options.title: Define a narrow retry and repair policy
options.body: Classify known npm failures, retry only idempotent transient network errors, and add platform-specific EACCES guidance or repair with focused Bash and PowerShell tests.

options.title: Improve diagnostics only
options.body: Keep install behavior mostly unchanged while adding clear remediation text for EACCES, ENOSPC, EBADENGINE, and network or certificate failures.

options.title: Keep current partial handling
options.body: Accept the current npm code/syscall/errno output and targeted cleanup retries without broadening installer policy.

recommendation.title: Define a narrow retry and repair policy
recommendation.body: Classify known npm failures, retry only idempotent transient network errors, and add platform-specific EACCES guidance or repair with focused Bash and PowerShell tests.

likelyOwner.reason: This account has the strongest recent source history across the Bash, PowerShell, and Docker setup files implicated by the decision.
